pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pCollects recipe-defined health nutrient or existing health-module contents and fills a destination module. Matching Tanzanite networks can supply leaf nutrient.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Inspect the current Health Processor value recipes.$p2. Place the destination Health/Nutrition Module in its module slot.$p3. Connect compatible leaves and keep the traversal loaded and permitted.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pNot every edible item is a health source. The health program uses its own value recipes.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pProcessing / value recipes: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
